head_commit.message:
fix(black-owned-catalog-sync): answer OPTIONS so governed reachability probes pass (#696)

The Production contract probe sends OPTIONS and expects 200/204 to prove the
function booted. The worker returned 405 for every non-POST method, so its first
Production deploy (run 41623079930) passed health, identity and the 401
unauthorized probe but failed "reachable" and was rolled back.

Return a bare 204 for OPTIONS (no CORS grant), matching the other governed
server-only functions. Every other non-POST method is still 405, and POST still
requires the worker secret. The black-owned-discovery bundle is unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Justin Smith <justin.landes@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
